notes.title: Worlds Adrift - Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/LD9TQzM.gif

After four years of development, and a boatload of anticipation, the world’s first Community-Crafted MMO, Worlds Adrift, begins its journey into Early Access today!

Created by Bossa Studios, the brains behind the acclaimed Surgeon Simulator and I am Bread, Worlds Adrift is our most ambitious game yet, offering an entirely user-generated environment, with a completely unscripted style of play. 

Previously in Closed Beta, Worlds Adrift today launches into Early Access and begins a new chapter in its development. 

To celebrate this milestone Worlds Adrift now includes a new culture - the Kioki Unity - and over 100 new islands from our Island Creator community.  For a quick preview of some of the new Kioki islands take a look at the GIF above!

Worlds Adrift will continue to evolve throughout Early Access, based on the extensive feedback you, our loyal band of Travellers, continue to provide.  To follow progress and receive the latest updates sign up to our newsletter and follow our Roadmap.

See you in the Skies!

EXPLORE. BUILD. UNITE.

Worlds Adrift  is launching with the latest build, 0.2.0, updates include:

Additional servers for both US and EU regions
The world has been wiped, and will launch with a brand new layout with brand new islands
The new world is now separated into two diverse cultural regions; Saborian and Kioki, the latter bringing with it all-new music and assets
Numerous new clothing items from Sabor, Bandinia, Ishgiru, Karem, Pin
A brand new in-game feedback form
Multiple bug fixes
Probably new ones...
VFX and SFX improvements

notes.title: Oculus Rift & Razer Hydra
notes.content:
Important information about the Oculus Rift & Razer Hydra implementation

With the upcoming releases of Surgeon Sim (1.160+), we have moved the VR functionality into a separate beta build. This is to alleviate some of the issues some players were having where the drivers for these devices were not playing nice with their system.

Now the VR functionality has been moved to an opt-in beta (that is open to everyone).

If you own an Oculus Rift or Razer Hydra and want to continue playing with your devices just follow these steps :

 Right click on Surgeon Simulator in your Steam library and select properties...

http://static.bossastudios.com/ss13_vrmode/step1.png

 Click on the BETAS tab.

http://static.bossastudios.com/ss13_vrmode/step2.png

 Select the "vr - Beta release" from the dropdown list.

http://static.bossastudios.com/ss13_vrmode/step3.png

That's it! Close the properties window and your game should begin updating to include the VR drivers.


In the future this functionality may be merged back into the main build as we see the drivers becoming more stable

Hope this helps :)

Tom
